mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post (user_id, title, cover_image, status, audit_status, publish_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{coverImage}, #{status}, #{auditStatus}, #{publishTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, title, cover_image, status, audit_status, audit_time, audit_remark, visibility, is_top, like_count, comment_count, collect_count, view_count, publish_time, create_time, update_time FROM post WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT p.id, p.user_id AS userId, p.title, p.cover_image AS coverImage, p.like_count AS likeCount, p.comment_count AS commentCount, p.collect_count AS collectCount, p.view_count AS viewCount, p.publish_time AS publishTime, u.nickname AS authorNickname, u.avatar AS authorAvatar FROM post p LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = p.user_id
p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1 AND p.audit_status != 2 AND (p.visibility = 0 OR p.user_id = #{currentUserId})
AND p.user_id = #{query.userId}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM post_tag pt WHERE pt.post_id = p.id AND pt.tag_id = #{query.tagId} )
AND p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY p.is_top DESC, p.publish_time DESC
